# Holi QR

Holi QR is a private, offline-capable QR workspace. It generates QR codes in
the browser, supports advanced styling with saved styles and style links, and
exports/copies the rendered image.

## URL

- https://qr.holi.tools/

## Capabilities

- Generate QR codes for URL, text, WiFi, vCard, email, SMS, phone, location,
  event, Bitcoin, app stores, and social links.
- Customize ink, paper, background, body shape, eye shape, gradients, texture
  images, logo, liquid effects, blur, noise, an optional text frame, and
  export size.
- Save styles in the browser, import/export them as JSON, and share a style
  through a link whose URL fragment carries the style (never the content).
- Export SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, and PDF.
- Copy the visible styled QR image to the clipboard when browser permissions
  allow image clipboard writes.
- Verify scanability using client-side decoding.

## Implementation Parameters

- App package: `holi-qr`
- App path: `web/apps/qr`
- Core crate: `crates/core/holi-qr`
- WASM renderer: `crates/wasm/wasm-qr`
- Main controller: `web/apps/qr/src/lib/qr-controller.ts`
- Workspace shell: `web/apps/qr/src/lib/workspace/shell.ts`
- Portable style + links: `web/apps/qr/src/lib/workspace/style.ts`
- WebGL preview: `web/apps/qr/src/lib/webgl-liquid-renderer.ts`
- SVG renderer bridge: `web/apps/qr/src/lib/wasm-svg-renderer.ts`

## Privacy Notes

- QR contents and images are processed locally in the browser.
- No account is required.
- Exports are user-triggered.
- Saved styles stay in browser storage; style links put the style (not the
  content) in the URL fragment, which browsers do not send to servers.
- Cloudflare can observe connection metadata such as IP and request time while
  serving the app, but QR content is not sent as part of generation.
